LESSON: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relationship)
Topic 6.2: Trade and Finance in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Trade and Finance in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do Muslims spend their income?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the halal and haram sources of earning for legitimate livelihood
2. describe the legitimate ways of spending income to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s Pleasure
3. explain the importance of lawful earnings as an act of ibadah
4. apply the knowledge of the halal way of earning in daily life, g) appreciate halal sources of earning and spending as a fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s command

2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do Muslims spend their income?
2. Why should Muslims spend their income in a halal manner?
3. Why are some sources of earning considered haram in Islam?
